name: reimagine-it
title_zh: 只重排你已写下的内容，不新造一个字
tagline_zh: 把现有 HTML 里的标题、事实、人名、日期、数字、链接、邮箱、颜色，重排成一张更独立的页面。适合改稿、做信息图。
tagline_en: Turns headings, facts, names, dates, numbers, links, emails, and colors from your HTML into a stronger standalone.
desc_en: Content-Derived Design — reads existing HTML and writes a stronger standalone page from headings, facts, names, dates, numbers, links, emails, and colors already in that file. CLI: npx reimagine-it --auto -i page.html -o out.html; also variations, lock, and audit. Use when the user says /reimagine-it, "reimagine it", "reinvent this", "redesign this page", "make an infographic", wants a content-awa
why_zh: 它先解析你文件里已有的全部信息，再按结构重排，而不是凭空生成。改动可锁定、可审计，适合对内容有洁癖的人。
why_en: It parses every fact already in your file, then restructures—never invents. Changes are lockable and auditable, for people with.
limit_zh: 只认 HTML 输入，且只重排文件里已有的内容；不会补写缺失信息，也不处理图片、PDF、Word。
limit_en: HTML input only; rearranges existing content, never fills gaps. No images, PDFs, or Word. Output is standalone HTML—no deployment or extra styling.
title_en: Rearranges only what you wrote, adds nothing new
